accepted_semantics.finding: All throwing checks and caller/capture construction precede the final actor owner assignment. The same immutable caller then returns without another await or throwing check.

accepted_semantics.boundary: Original parent and whole UI lifetime
accepted_semantics.finding: Forwarded original methods retain the same registered actor/caller capture. Finite original UI operations own admissions through their Seed/default-space/state continuation, while the temporary UI attempt does not replace OriginalAuthRequestContext.parent or become an artificial startup ancestor. Retirement/cancellation uses actual original capture validation.

Four auxiliary named original RPCs reject any preexisting unrelated Invocation binding, permit only the exact named call and retain original captures in actual Invocation completion. The follow-up releases local admissions and outer lease before awaiting that same attempt drain, then validates again. It cannot self-deadlock by retaining its own outer admission. WalletConvert is separately bound through the original registered Auth wrapper. All five original service call sites match actual Git.

Synchronous caller retirement prevents later admission. One retained close joins an accepted Stop or dispatches original logout(false) before awaiting a retired startup. Actual original AccountStop.invoke has no ACCOUNT_IS_NOT_RUNNING success conversion. Failed Stop retains successfulStopRequired and the same close owner; only explicit retry may replace the returned failed close task. Drain-only receipt applies only when no startup was admitted. Release requires successful auth close and does not manufacture facade FIFO/consumer/selection drain facts.

accepted_semantics.boundary: Real recovery identity and callback ordering
accepted_semantics.finding: The native-facing callback enqueues and returns; original event handler sends the subject; the Login for-await body records the current recovery reference and native account ID without joining. A MainActor-created real Task is stored before it can dispatch. Only the separately scheduled select task awaits that exact throwing task completion, then rechecks the same operation/caller and exact UTF8 ID before original select. No event or UI scheduling token is treated as native/account authority.

Wallet caller cancellation requests task.cancel but does not claim task completion. Select cancellation does not cancel the recovery and is checked through actual caller.validateCurrent after its await; original attempt validation also checks Task cancellation. A failed recovery throws through task.value and blocks select. Private per-recovery UUID plus native account ID changes the original task(id:) key for an explicit same-ID retry, stays stable for duplicate events on the same recovery, and is never passed to Auth/native. Nil caller retains original accountId scheduling.

Reuse accepted synchronous original storage/callback review. Six paths preserve the accepted bodies except the explicitly proved empty-line spaces; Auth coordinator carries the same caller. No new storage engine or async import task is invented. Historically admitted effects are retained honestly.
